00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000021.title: Mara’s flat
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000021.synopsis: A small flat above a bakery in the city. No maps on the walls except the ones she draws for work, and one atlas on the shelf.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000021.notes: The safe, measured life she built. It should feel thin once the letter arrives.

00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000022.title: The ferry office
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000022.synopsis: A paint-flaked ticket office at the mainland harbor with a timetable that says there has never been a ferry to Bellwether.
00d1e246-4f36-47e8-a308-000000000022.notes: Liminal. Tomas mends nets here for boats that do not exist.
